Description.Name: Raine
Description.Details:
Christine North was born on Dieron in 3017, the daughter of two devoted ComStar members stationed at the planetary HPG station. Growing up in the shadow of the transmitter complex, she was raised in an environment defined by discipline, secrecy, and technical precision.

From an early age Christine demonstrated exceptional aptitude in her studies, excelling in both theoretical and practical training within the ComStar education system. Her performance quickly attracted the attention of ComStar recruiters, and she was selected for advanced training with the Com Guards.

Christine proved herself a natural pilot. In the cockpit she displayed remarkable combat instincts and composure under pressure. Throughout her training cycles she consistently ranked at the top of her unit, earning a reputation for reliable performance and precise tactical awareness.

In 3046 Christine was selected for assignment to the highly classified Project GUNGIR alongside fellow pilot Lan. As part of the program she was chosen to pilot one of the prototype GN machines during early test trials and combat simulations.

Her steady performance and adaptability during these trials helped validate several experimental systems being evaluated by the project.

Following the conclusion of the initial testing phase, Christine Raine and Lan were reassigned to operational duty within the 301st Com Guards, where their experience with advanced prototype technology was expected to provide a significant advantage in future deployments.
